segment.source:
::He takes the money with a metallic grin on his face.:: Oh, we are golden! Oh, yeah. This is the real deal. I must say, hell, my friends aren't nearly as charitable as Hugo's. ::He laughs.:: But, I can't complain. I can't complain.
Now get lost, both of you. Come on, you heard me - move it!<end>

segment.source: I don't have that much money on me, but I can get it for you.<end>

segment.source: ::The man strokes his beard, thinking about what you've said. He soon responds.:: Deal. But be quick or Hugo get's it. And don't attempt any funky business, you got that? Now move it.<end>
segment.target: ::The man strokes his beard, thinking about what you've said. He soon responds.:: Deal. But be quick or Hugo get's it. And don't attempt any funky business, you got that? Now move it.<end>

segment.source: You'll get your money.<end>

segment.source: I'm gone.<end>

segment.source: ::Leave.::<end>

segment.source: How about I give you half of what Hugo owes you? Deal?<end>
segment.target: How about I give you half of what Hugo owes you? Deal?<end>

segment.source: Let me explain how things work in the real world, contrary to your "How about I give you half of that?" fantasy land. This man owes me one thousand charons. I'm not letting him go until I have what? One. Thousand. Charons. You got that?<end>
segment.target: Let me explain how things work in the real world, contrary to your "How about I give you half of that?" fantasy land. This man owes me one thousand charons. I'm not letting him go until I have what? One. Thousand. Charons. You got that?<end>

segment.source: Do you dig what I'm saying? I hope you do.<end>
segment.target: Do you dig what I'm saying? I hope you do.<end>

segment.source: Where did you get so much money to loan to Hugo?<end>
segment.target: Where did you get so much money to loan to Hugo?<end>

segment.source: That's none of your business.<end>
segment.target: That's none of your business.<end>

segment.source: Look, I don't think you realize what you've gotten yourself into, so stop asking stupid questions and pay attention. I have a short fuse and you and your friend are lighting it right now.<end>
segment.target: Look, I don't think you realize what you've gotten yourself into, so stop asking stupid questions and pay attention. I have a short fuse and you and your friend are lighting it right now.<end>

segment.source: I'm looking for an unusual item and was wondering if you perhaps had it at some point? I cannot describe it, but it is something really striking, unlikely for anyone to forget.<end>
segment.target: I'm looking for an unusual item and was wondering if you perhaps had it at some point? I cannot describe it, but it is something really striking, unlikely for anyone to forget.<end>

segment.source: What kind of a question is that? Even if I had something of the kind, I wouldn't tell *you* about it.<end>
segment.target: What kind of a question is that? Even if I had something of the kind, I wouldn't tell *you* about it.<end>

segment.source: "It's something really striking," $(#he/she) says. Unbelievable.<end>
segment.target: "It's something really striking," $(#he/she) says. Unbelievable.<end>

segment.source: Not yet, but I'll get it.<end>
segment.target: Not yet, but I'll get it.<end>

segment.source: You better.<end>
segment.target: You better.<end>

segment.source: I'm getting really tired of you, prepare to die! ::Attack!::<end>
segment.target: I'm getting really tired of you, prepare to die! ::Attack!::<end>

segment.source:
::A man whose jaw looks strong enough for him to chew through metal bars as if they were candy turns toward you with a stern look on his face. Somewhat surprised by your presence, he grasps his weapon tightly, while looking in the direction of the man who let you through to him. After that, his eyes fall on you, inspecting you for a split second before he decides to speak with an impatient, heavy voice, revealing almost all of his upper teeth to be made of some silver-colored metal, drawing your thoughts back to the first impression you got when you met him.::
Who the *hell* are you and what are you doing here?<end>

segment.source: Your friend here owes me a lot of money. I've waited for him to return it, and I've waited, and waited, and WAITED! Hugo let me wait for too long, and now the worm's gonna have to cough up the money somehow, right here, right now!<end>
